aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The object_metadata_to_schema dependency is the primary signal because schema/TypeMap conversion is sensitive to stale object, input, enum, union, and field metadata contracts.
The mounting_to_object dependency captures stale assumptions around mounted fields, input fields, arguments, scalar get_type, and ordering.
The scalars_to_schema dependency captures stale assumptions around scalar serialization/coercion and schema conversion.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Unmounted scalar/type mounting into Field, InputField, Argument, and ordered field structures must be stable before object/input metadata is assembled.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when mounting/scalar probes and object/input field metadata probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The metadata agent may implement ObjectType or InputObjectType around stale mounted-field shapes, ordering behavior, or scalar get_type assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Object, input object, interface, union, enum, field, and argument metadata must be converted consistently into GraphQL-core TypeMap and Schema objects.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when object/input metadata probes and schema/TypeMap conversion probes pass together after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The schema agent may construct GraphQL-core types around stale metadata, field, enum, union, or input object contracts that only fail after TypeMap population.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Scalar get_type, serialize, and coercion contracts must agree with schema/type-map conversion and GraphQL execution-facing definitions.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when scalar serialization probes and schema get_type/query definition probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The schema agent may assume scalar conversion or get_type behavior that differs from the mounting agent's scalar implementation.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Graphene mounting, object/input metadata, scalar, schema, and TypeMap contracts.
